### 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or new historical expedition you would like to see.

### 🎬 Documentary / Use Case
How will this feature help video creators, educators, or documentarians? (e.g. "I'm making a video about the Apollo missions and need orbital tracking arcs.")

### 🗺️ Proposed Implementation / Reference
If this involves a historical route, list:
- Departure and Destination cities (with lat/lon if known)
- Preferred trajectory / color / style
- Historical era or reference links

### 📌 Additional Context
Add any screenshots, reference documentary clips, or diagrams here.
